name: Gabe Amo
stance: Signed the bipartisan call for urgent federal guardrails and oversight of advanced AI; a member of the Congressional AI Caucus.

statements.text: This decision will erode the edge the United States maintains over China’s AI program and threaten our national security.
Trump is handing our opponents our coordinates in the middle of a battle by selling China high-powered AI chips. It puts our national security at risk.
Trump should not be selling our advanced AI chips to China. He’s giving the advantage to an adversary, and I want to know why.
The President of the United States bought millions in NVIDIA stock, then approved advanced AI chip sales to China.
Joined 19 colleagues in calling for AI executives to testify before Congress about what they are doing to stop AI jailbreaks, protect jobs and keep American systems safe.
Government’s role is to keep people safe. Congress must act now to stop AI from causing irreparable harm.
Went to @sciencedems briefing with frontier AI companies. It’s abundantly clear: AI is moving too fast & we need to regulate.
One of ten signers of a bipartisan letter to House leadership urging urgent legislation on AI oversight, security and transparency after advanced-AI 'loss-of-control' incidents.

After President Xi’s visit, we need diplomacy, not pageantry, to set guardrails & keep people safe. Alongside 28 of my @HouseForeign colleagues, we’re calling for real dialogue with China to address AI safety.

review.note: added October 2026; record verified via the lead's primary release
